changelog:
Email Customer Assistant 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Connects to any IMAP mailbox to read emails
- Classifies emails by urgency (Urgent, Important, Normal, Can Wait) using AI
- Generates multi-language reply suggestions for user confirmation before sending
- Pushes real-time email summaries to Feishu group chats or DMs
- Supports four pricing tiers with different mailbox and usage limits
- Simple configuration for IMAP, AI API, and Feishu integration
summary: Connects to IMAP mailboxes to classify emails by urgency, suggests multilingual replies, and pushes real-time summaries to Feishu chats.
